Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage first grade 6450924699, verbatim: "**p2:** saving a permission set in Studio starts from the published body, so it drops draft values another door wrote (`description`, `packageId`). Save from the current draft and merge only the edited keys. Re-check the landing site on current `main`." No maintainer ruling.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

- On `origin/main` `3230bdbf`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` ≈L1283-1296 (package-scope save) re-reads `client.layered(type, payload.name)` and merges onto `fresh?.effective ?? payload`, i.e. the PUBLISHED body. A pending package draft written by another door (its `description`, `packageId`, any non-authored key) is therefore replaced by published values on save.
- The load path already reads the pending draft through `readDraftForSave` (`DraftConflictDialog.js`, ≈L820-850). Reuse that door for the save base: when the package door holds a pending draft, merge onto the draft; otherwise keep the published `effective`. ⛔ Do not hand-build a draft query.
- "Merge only the edited keys" = the existing `mergePermissionSlice` contract: only `EDITOR_AUTHORED_KEYS` (`permission-slice.ts` ≈L257) come from the editor, the rest from the base. Measure that it already holds; change the base, not the key list, unless measurement shows a key leak.
- Keep both deliberate arms intact: a REJECTED re-read still refuses the save (`perm.save.rereadFailed`, objectui#9420), and the 404 shape keeps the `?? payload` base for a set that exists only as a package draft. A rejected draft read must refuse the same way, not fall back to published.
- Environment scope (no `packageId`) keeps the whole-record save unchanged.

### Scope

File surface: `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` (the package-scope save base), `permission-slice.ts` only if measurement demands it, and tests. Tests: a pending draft whose `description` and `packageId` differ from published survives a save byte-for-byte while the edited rows land; with no pending draft the base is still the published `effective`; a rejected draft read refuses the save. Ablation: base back on `fresh?.effective` ⇒ the draft-survival test goes red.

Serial: PR #26999 (#26858, verdict state) and the #26840 thread (load path, same file) both edit this file. Merge `origin/main` again before your gates and name any still-open one in the report.

### Tier

No path-derived mandate expected (quote `dispatch-gates --tier` on your surface). `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `medium` (S). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. No changeset (`@object-ui/app-shell` is private); put `skip-changeset` in the `pr_create` labels.
